verses.pali: “Aṭṭhānametaṁ, bhikkhave, anavakāso yaṁ itthī sakkattaṁ kāreyya …pe… mārattaṁ kāreyya …pe… brahmattaṁ kāreyya. Netaṁ ṭhānaṁ vijjati.
verses.english: “It is impossible, mendicants, it cannot happen for a woman to perform the role of Sakka, Māra, or the Divinity.

verses.pali: Ṭhānañca kho etaṁ, bhikkhave, vijjati yaṁ puriso sakkattaṁ kāreyya …pe… mārattaṁ kāreyya …pe… brahmattaṁ kāreyya. Ṭhānametaṁ vijjatī”ti.
verses.english: But it is possible for a man to perform the role of Sakka, Māra, or the Divinity.”
